title: fix: remove the unauthenticated image cache delete route
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the image cache’s DELETE /delete/prompt/:prompt route and DELETE from its allowed CORS methods. Requests to the removed route now return 404 without deleting the stored image. The route-only cache deletion and legacy-key helpers were also removed.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears a tiny caretaker’s hat and checks that a picture remains tucked in a lime green (#ecf874) cache cabinet beside a flowering code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, with chunky retro sprites, a warm cream and pastel gradient background, soft CRT glow, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
